==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Dinraal}}
Dinraal is one of three roaming [[Dragon]]s in [[Hyrule]], the others being [[Naydra]] and [[Farosh]]. She can be found roaming the [[Eldin (Region)|Eldin]] [[Region]], the [[Great Hyrule Forest]], [[Akkala]], and [[Hebra]]. Dinraal guards the [[Spring of Power]]. While it cannot be defeated, it does not actively try to harm Link. Despite this, if Link gets too close, he will be seared by the [[Fire]] emanating from its body.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/> Link can avoid her Fire by drinking [[Fireproof Elixir]]s or wearing the full [[Flamebreaker Set|Fireproof Armor]] that has been enhanced twice by a [[Great Fairy]].

Dinraal will drop different [[Material]]s if Link shoots it with a [[Bow]]. Depending on what part of Dinraal is hit, it will drop a [[Shard of Dinraal's Horn]], [[Shard of Dinraal's Fang]], [[Dinraal's Claw]] or [[Dinraal's Scale]].

Dinraal's Scale can be offered at the [[Spring of Power]] to unlock a hidden [[Ancient Shrine]].

==Nomenclature==
Dinraal's name is a reference to the golden goddess [[Din]]. Her Japanese and various localized names seem to derive from [[Eldin (Dragon)|Eldin]], which itself comes from Din as well.
